title: Capped bar rise with outline stat
summary: Five flat colour bars with detached white caps rise together from a baseline while their values count up, the header lifts to the top and an outline growth figure steps in. One move, then a long readable hold.
use_when: A square stat card for a monthly or quarterly growth number
Opening a data story with one headline figure backed by five values
A silent social post where the chart must read in under 3 s
Dashboard or report teasers with a flat, poster-like palette

look.type_style: bold grotesk numerals inside bars (7 % H) with a small superscript unit; outline-only display figure (14 % H, 2 px stroke); small uppercase grotesk chip labels (2.5 % H); regular grotesk category labels (2.5 % H)

sfx.event: bars and header start their rise (f37)
values counting up during the rise

structure.shot: empty dark square; outlined label chip and filled year chip at mid height left, small mark right, five white baseline caps
structure.motion: f0-7 empty; chips fade in from f8, year fill brightens to white by f37 (easings.linear); mark grows from a flat line f8 -> full f15 (logo-from-dot); caps draw left to right from f13, stagger 1 fr, thicken 2 -> 8 px, settled f28

structure.shot: the five bars rise to unequal heights with live values inside; header lifts to the top edge; outline growth figure appears under it; month labels rise in at the bar feet
structure.motion: bars and header ride one curve f37-f80 (43 fr): accelerating lead f37-f48 (easings.inExpo 11 fr), peak 62 px/fr on the tallest bar at f48, then easings.outQuint 32 fr tail, no overshoot at 30 fps; header travels 515 px up; values count with the bar height, last tick f84; outline figure steps in per character f46-f53, 1-2 fr each; month labels rise in at the bar feet f60-f68 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: settled chart: header chips and mark on top, outline figure, five capped bars with values and month labels
structure.motion: full hold 36 fr, nothing moves after f84

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, fg for caps and chips, display font for values, one accent for the tallest bar
params.content.label: uppercase chip label, 1 word
params.content.period: filled chip text, e.g. a year, 4 chars
params.content.figure: headline growth figure shown as outline type, <= 5 chars
params.content.bars: exactly 5 {value, label, color}; value in thousands, label 3 chars
params.content.unit: superscript unit after each value, 1 char
params.timing.riseAt: frame the rise starts (default 37 at 30 fps)
params.aspect: 1:1 default; 4:5 and 9:16 keep the chart bottom-anchored

notes: Measured at 30 fps from the source (column scans): caps first appear f15-f20 with 1 fr stagger; rise f37-f80 with the header lifting 516 px on the same curve; final bar heights 374/511/280/632/414 px of 1188 for values 18/24/14/30/20 (21 px per unit, baseline 4.5 % from bottom); bar width 18 % W, gap 0.7 % W; cap 18 px tall, 8 px above the bar. The catalogue hint of overshoot is not confirmed: heights are monotone to the last frame. Counters and bar heights share one progress. Proposed terms (recipe.md only): char-step-in, layout-lift, label-foot-rise. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (source is silent).
